title: A Thorn for the Salt Again
author: Wendell Winterbourne
blurb: Edmund Underhill, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
